summary: Super Micro Computer, Inc. filed an 8-K regarding the issuance of 75 million depositary shares (plus over-allotment) representing its 7.00% Series A Mandatory Convertible Preferred Stock under a shelf registration statement. The offering closed on June 15, 2026 at a liquidation preference of $1,000 per share of preferred stock. This is a routine capital markets transaction, not a special situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special situation is present. The filing covers standard underwriting agreements, certificate of designations, and deposit agreement.
